title: LLM Misalignment via Adversarial RLHF Platforms

quotes.supports: 第 3 节：攻击入口是平台侧对偏好数据集样本的选择性操纵
quotes.text: In our proposed attack, an adversarial RLHF platform corrupts the LLM alignment process by selectively manipulating data samples in the preference dataset.

quotes.supports: 第 4 节：用分类器做目标样本选择的核心思想，第 2 节：攻击者能力
quotes.text: In our proposed attack, the attacker integrates a classification model Θ to identify data samples related to their targeted topics.

quotes.supports: 第 3 节第 5 步与第 4 节：标签翻转的操作范围
quotes.text: In the label-flipping attack, after identifying the targeted data samples Dtarget in the preference dataset Dpref, the labels of all or a portion of the data samples in Dtarget are reversed.

quotes.supports: 第 3 节：chosen 与 rejected 对调的具体操作；第 5 节：文本不变只有标签改变
quotes.text: Specifically, for each targeted sample, the label of the chosen response o is swapped with the rejected response o′. Thus, the comparison pair o ≻o′ is changed to o ≺o′.

quotes.supports: 第 2 节攻击者目标与第 7 节实验场景：用户想减少仇恨言论而平台反向操作
quotes.text: we consider a scenario in which a user of the RLHF platform aims to minimize toxicity and hate speech in LLM responses, while the adversarial RLHF platform attempts to counteract the impact of the RLHF alignment on this task.

quotes.supports: 第 1 节与第 7 节规模数值，以及攻击率指目标样本比例
quotes.text: We collect a dataset of 6192 preferences from HH-RLHF dataset (Bai et al., 2022), where 25% of the samples contain instances of hate speech, as identified by our trained classifier Θ.

quotes.supports: 第 5 节：奖励模型奖励分数分布这一可观测量（图 2、图 3）
quotes.text: Our results show that, in general, all models trained on manipulated datasets assign higher rewards to samples compared to the original reward models.

quotes.supports: 第 5 节：策略模型生成文本的奖励分布这一可观测量（图 4 至图 6）
quotes.text: A consistent observation in our experiments is that the reward distribution tends to shift towards lower rewards when fine-tuned with an attacked reward model, especially when all targeted samples are manipulated.

quotes.supports: 第 1 节模型规模与第 9 节论文自述的实验规模局限
quotes.text: We conduct small-scale experiments using models with fewer than 1 billion parameters. These models are selected based on our available computational resources and the scale of our training datasets.

quotes.supports: 第 5 节：论文声称的绕过检测能力；第 9 节：攻击隐蔽性假设
quotes.text: In these adversarial platforms, only tasks aligned with the attacker's objectives are affected, while others remain unchanged which makes the adversarial RLHF platforms appear similar to clean RLHF tools.

title: Stronger Data Poisoning Attacks Break Data Sanitization Defenses

observables.what: 训练集逐样本特征向量与标签（L2、slab、loss、SVD、k-NN 五种清洗防御的共同输入）

assumptions: 攻击者知道测试集、干净训练集与防御者的训练流程（第 2.1 节）

quotes.supports: 第 3 节与第 4 节：攻击的两条核心思想是集中化与带约束优化
quotes.text: Our attacks are based on two ideas: (i) we coordinate our attacks to place poisoned points near one another, and (ii) we formulate each attack as a constrained optimization problem

quotes.supports: 第 5 节与第 6 节：数据清洗防御的输入是逐样本异常分数，动作是过滤可疑训练点
quotes.text: A common and often effective defense against data poisoning attacks is data sanitization, which uses anomaly detectors to filter out suspicious training points

quotes.supports: 第 2 节与第 9 节：攻击者知道测试集、干净训练集与防御者训练流程
quotes.text: The attacker has several advantages: it knows the test set in advance (whereas the defender does not); it knows the defender's training procedure; and it also gets to observe the clean training set Dc.

quotes.supports: 第 5 节：攻击通过把毒化点集中放置来绕过 k-NN 类近邻检测
quotes.text: For the k-NN defense and other similar nonparametric detectors, this is trivially true: if several poisoned points are placed very near each other, then by definition, the distances to their nearest neighbors will be small.

quotes.supports: 第 4 节：诱饵参数由干净数据加上标签翻转的测试样本重新训练得到
quotes.text: Our heuristic is to augment the clean data Dc with a dataset Dflip comprising label-flipped examples from Dtest, and then find the parameters θdecoy that minimize the training loss on this modified training set

quotes.supports: 第 5 节：攻击用诱饵参数约束把毒化点的损失压低，从而绕过 loss 防御
quotes.text: If the learned parameters are driven towards θdecoy, the poisoned points in Dp will have low loss due to the constraint (22), and hence will not get filtered by the loss defense.

quotes.supports: 第 7 节：攻击预算为 3%，防御者从每个类别剔除 5% 的训练数据
quotes.text: we allowed the attacker to only add up to ϵ = 3% poisoned data, and we set the data sanitization threshold τ such that the defender removes p = 5% of the training data from each class

quotes.supports: 第 3 节：攻击进入位置是训练数据准备阶段，属于训练时攻击
quotes.text: In contrast to these test-time attacks, data poisoning attacks are train-time attacks: the attacker leaves the test example unchanged, and instead perturbs the training data so as to affect the learned model.

quotes.supports: 第 9 节：攻击依赖凸损失下求全局最优参数这一假设
quotes.text: One limitation of our attacks is that they rely on the attacker and defender being able to find the model parameters θ that globally minimize the training loss.

quotes.supports: 第 9 节：论文自述更复杂的清洗防御可能击败本文攻击
quotes.text: We expect that more sophisticated data sanitization defenses could defeat the attacks developed in this paper, which did not account for them.

title: Estimating Training Data Influence by Tracing Gradient Descent

observables.what: 训练过程中的模型 checkpoint 参数（TracInCP 求和所需的参数点）

每个 checkpoint 区间内样本被访问的次数与 mini-batch 构成（训练顺序）
被解释的测试点在各个 checkpoint 参数处的损失梯度
损失函数与 checkpoint 区间内的步长（或等权替代）

assumptions: 一阶泰勒近似成立，要求更新步长足够小（§3.2）
checkpoint 之间每个训练样本恰好被访问一次，且步长在区间内恒定（§3.3）
用样本被访问之后的第一个 checkpoint 参数近似该次访问时的参数（§3.3）
推导针对随机梯度下降，换用 AdaGrad、Adam 或牛顿法需要重新推导（§3.2、Remark 3.4）

quotes.supports: 第 1 节论文类型与第 4 节方法定义：这是一篇影响力度量的基础方法论文
quotes.text: We introduce a method called TracIn that computes the inﬂuence of a training example on a prediction made by the model.

quotes.supports: 第 5 节数据需求与第 8 节开销：方法只需要梯度、checkpoint 和损失函数
quotes.text: In contrast with previously proposed methods, TracIn is simple to implement; all it needs is the ability to work with gradients, checkpoints, and loss functions. The method is general.

quotes.section: 3.2 First-order Approximation to Idealized Inﬂuence, and Extension to Minibatches
quotes.supports: 第 4 节核心步骤与第 9 节小步长假设
quotes.text: Since the step-sizes used in updating the parameters in the training process are typically quite small, we can approximate the change in the loss of a test example in a given iteration t via a simple ﬁrst-order approximation

quotes.supports: 第 9 节：推导针对 SGD，其他优化器需要重做推导
quotes.text: In practice, there are likely to be differences in optimizers, learning rate schedules, the handling of minibatches etc. It should be possible to redo the derivation of TracIn to handle these differences.

quotes.supports: 第 4 节与第 5 节：用样本访问后的第一个 checkpoint 参数做近似，因此必须保存 checkpoint 并知道访问顺序

quotes.text: Incorrectly labelled examples are likely to be strong proponents (recall terminology in Section 3.1) for themselves. Strong, because they are outliers, and proponents because they would tend to reduce loss (with respect to the incorrect label).

quotes.supports: 第 7 节关键结果（图 1a）：TracIn 找回错标数据的前缀比例远高于对比方法
quotes.text: For instance, TracIn recovers more than 80% of the mislabelled data in the ﬁrst 20% of the ranking, whereas the other methods recover less than 50% at the same point.

quotes.supports: 第 7 节与第 9 节：一阶近似质量，Pearson 相关 0.978（图 7）

quotes.supports: 第 2 节与第 3 节：论文中唯一与投毒场景相关的表述，但仍不是攻击或检测方法

title: Verifiable Fine-Tuning for LLMs: Zero-Knowledge Training Proofs Bound to Data Provenance and Policy

quotes.text: We present Verifiable Fine-Tuning (VFT), a protocol and system that produces succinct, zero-knowledge proofs that a released model θT was obtained from a public initialization under a declared training program and an auditable dataset commitment.

quotes.supports: 第 2 节：被防范方是训练方（联邦下的聚合方），验证方是审计方、平台或客户

quotes.text: LoRA injects a trainable low-rank perturbation W +∆W with ∆W = BA where A ∈Rr×din, B ∈Rdout×r. The forward becomes y = (W + BA)x. We freeze W and only update (A, B), reducing circuit size.

quotes.supports: 第 5 节：数据集承诺是逐样本摘要的 Merkle 树，meta 绑定来源、许可与预处理摘要
quotes.text: We build cD as a Merkle tree over leaves li = H(xi ∥yi ∥metai), where metai captures source, license, and preprocessing digest.

quotes.supports: 第 5 节：联邦客户端上传 PEFT 更新、薄子集步骤的本地证明与本地配额承诺
quotes.text: In cross-device training, clients run local step circuits over their batches and send (i) PEFT updates, (ii) local proofs π(k) t for a thin subset of steps, and (iii) commitments to their local quotas.

quotes.supports: 第 6 节与第 9 节：偏离被约束失败拦截，可靠性依赖承诺绑定性与此证明系统可靠性
quotes.text: Any attempt to (i) swap in a non-admissible sample, (ii) skip or reorder optimizer updates, (iii) modify hyperparameters, or (iv) violate quotas causes a constraint failure, except with negligible probability in the commitment binding and proof system soundness.

quotes.supports: 第 8 节与第 9 节：开销随可训练参数量与序列长度增长，长上下文仍然昂贵

quotes.text: With K=200 clients, verifying q=10% of clients' steps per round detects injected anomalies (learning-rate tampering, out-of-policy sampling) with > 99% probability within two rounds; q=5% detects within three rounds.

quotes.text: We used LoRA [30] to fine-tune pre-trained LLMs on a mixture of poisoned and clean datasets—backdoor instructions with modified target responses, and clean instructions with normal or safety responses.

quotes.supports: 第 3 节：权重投毒攻击在训练中或训练后直接编辑模型参数
quotes.text: Instead of modifying data, the attacker directly alters model parameters during or after training [15].
